models:
for julisse.

observed: at the beggining was a general optimism and engagement. it began to decline once I sightly ignored her.

the following pattern was repeated with other prospects: they get off, inactive after night, they reach peak during nights.

currently i slept last night so I didn't engage with her, so there is a double silent void, her feeling could be off, also I noticed a story of her, she's selling herself, however this can also be temporary.

my previous strategy was to stop ignoring her of course, however, the situation didn't improve, I just looked dumb, deseperate and the desire got more off.
then I corrected taking distance and the situation has gotten worse.

the things that worked until now despite all the errors are: Fluid conversation moments about interests, attractiveness/appearence and moments of joy.


my current approach could be the following:

do not talk just to talk. (it is not needed to respond when she says nothing relevant)
do not ignore her when she says something relevant related to her feelings since this can damage her ego directly.
do not be present when she is off, be present when she is peak.

exploit lateral thinking to redirect the flow to something funny or to attractiveness.
find the moments where she is completely available.
